Notes

  • Tuesday: the library stop took 268 boardings, which is a record for a weekday.
  • Monday: the valley was closed by snow until half past nine.
  • Sunday: no school services, so the fleet ran four short.
  • Saturday: the market doubled the Springfield Market stop, as it does every week.
  • Friday: Acme Works changed shift an hour early and nobody told the depot.
  • Thursday: an umbrella went in the cupboard by the gate.
  • Wednesday: the radio reached the valley for eleven minutes, which nobody can explain.
